contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

A base sherd from a Roman Central Gaulish Les Martres-de-Veyre samian ware plate/bowl, possibly Form Drag 18 or 31 dating to AD 140-165. The remaining sherd consists of part of the foot ring and base of the vessel.
